header.title: Providers
header.text: The certification bodies your trainings are grouped under - Red Hat, AWS, and the like.

table.text: Every provider on the platform. You can only edit or delete the ones you created, unless you're a SuperAdmin.

header.text: The courses in your catalog, each tied to a provider.
